summary:
ExoPioneer: Lunar & Mars Outpost Survival Simulator is an interactive web-based educational game designed to demonstrate the challenges of sustaining human life on the Moon and Mars. We developed a browser-based simulation where players take the role of an astronaut mission commander and manage essential habitat resources, including oxygen, water, food, energy, radiation protection, and habitat integrity.

Players can choose between a lunar or Martian mission, make daily operational decisions, and respond to unexpected events such as water leaks, power failures, and environmental hazards. The objective is to keep the crew and habitat operational for 30 simulated days.

The project addresses the challenge by making space exploration concepts interactive and engaging. It helps learners understand resource management, sustainability, and the complex decisions involved in planning long-duration human space missions.
details:
Project Overview

ExoPioneer: Lunar & Mars Outpost Survival Simulator is an interactive web-based educational simulation that demonstrates the challenges of sustaining human life on the Moon and Mars. The project allows users to experience the role of an astronaut mission commander responsible for maintaining a space outpost.

How It Works

Users can choose between two mission environments: the Moon and Mars. They must manage six essential survival factors: oxygen, water, food, energy, radiation protection, and habitat integrity.

The simulation progresses day by day. Users can perform different actions, such as deploying solar panels, expanding greenhouse facilities, improving radiation protection, maintaining water recycling systems, repairing the habitat, and conducting scientific experiments.

Unexpected events, including water leaks, power failures, and environmental hazards, make resource management more challenging. The objective is to maintain the outpost and successfully survive 30 simulated days.

Benefits and Intended Impact

ExoPioneer makes space exploration concepts easier to understand through interactive learning. It helps students and space enthusiasts understand the importance of resource conservation, sustainable living, environmental protection, and decision-making during long-duration space missions.

The project aims to increase awareness of the challenges involved in establishing sustainable human settlements beyond Earth.

Tools and Technologies Used

The project was developed using:

  • HTML – Structure of the web application.
  • CSS – User interface design and visual presentation.
  • JavaScript – Simulation logic, resource management, daily events, and user interactions.
  • Web Browser – Running and testing the application.
  • GitHub – Source code hosting and project sharing.

No additional hardware or backend server is required. The application runs directly in a web browser.

Creativity and Innovation

The creative aspect of ExoPioneer is its combination of space exploration and resource-management gameplay. Instead of simply presenting information about Moon and Mars missions, it allows users to make decisions and experience how those decisions affect the survival of an outpost.

The ability to select different planetary environments, manage multiple survival resources, perform maintenance activities, and respond to unexpected events makes the learning experience interactive and engaging.

Factors Considered During Development

During development, I considered simplicity, accessibility, educational value, and ease of use. The application was designed to run in a standard web browser without requiring installation or specialized hardware.

I also considered the importance of resource balance, environmental challenges, unexpected emergencies, and the need to maintain a habitat over an extended period. The simulation uses simplified educational values rather than real mission engineering specifications.
